verdict.rationale: Groq is an API-first inference service with extensive public docs for an OpenAI-compatible REST API: Chat Completions, a Responses API, tool use, structured outputs, batch, service tiers and streaming. It also ships an official TypeScript SDK for the REST API, and community users report running workloads through it. LLM-friendly docs are reachable via llms.txt and .md pages. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404).
